name: request_map_effect_stop

stack.evidence: func_001E07D8 consumes a map-effect ID, resolves it through func_00177608, and sets the resolved PPP object's per-effect stop byte at offset 0x85 to 1

notes: The PPP manager tests offset 0x85 in func_00184E80 and func_00184F60 to switch an active effect to its stop/completion path. The three JP calls request stops for map-effect IDs 1, 2, and 3; the ID-3 call is immediately followed by command 187 delete_map_effect.
